extracted.intended_audience: Broadcasters, licensees, petitioners, and interested members of the public who may file comments or participate in FCC rulemaking (MB Docket No. 24-193)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and technical requirements for participating in the FCC's Notice of Proposed Rulemaking to add FM Channel 284A at Huntley, Montana, including filing deadlines, service instructions, ex parte restrictions, and engineering/site-restriction details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be filed on or before August 19, 2024, and reply comments on or before September 3, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates are printed on the first page of the document; comments are subject to the deadlines stated under DATES.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods for filing comments (electronic and paper)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments may be filed electronically using the Commission's Electronic Comment Filing System (ECFS) or by paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic Filers: file via https://www.fcc.gov/ecfs/. Paper Filers: must file an original and one copy of each filing; filings can be sent by hand/messenger, commercial courier, or U.S. Postal Service. Addressing and delivery instructions are provided (Secretary, Federal Communications Commission; hand-delivered/messenger accepted 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.; commercial courier and USPS addresses specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper filing form and physical delivery requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Parties who choose to file by paper must file an original and one copy of each filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hand-delivered or messenger-delivered paper filings accepted between 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. by the FCC's mailing contractor at 9050 Junction Drive, Annapolis Junction, MD 20701. All hand deliveries must be held together with rubber bands or fasteners and any envelopes and boxes must be disposed of before entering the building. Commercial courier deliveries have a specified address; USPS First-Class/Priority/Express have a separate specified address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service on petitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to filing comments with the FCC, interested parties should serve the petitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serve Matthew K. Wesolowski, CEO, SSR Communications, Inc., 740 Highway 49 North, Suite R, Flora, MS 39071, matt@wyab.com (contact information provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility accommodations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for requesting materials in accessible formats for people with disabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To request materials in braille, large print, electronic files, or audio format, send an email to fcc504@fcc.gov or call the Consumer & Governmental Affairs Bureau at 202-418-0530.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex parte contact prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: From issuance of a notice of proposed rulemaking until the matter is no longer subject to Commission consideration or court review, all ex parte contacts are prohibited in Commission proceedings that involve channel allotments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 47 CFR 1.1204(b) for rules governing permissible ex parte contacts; members of the public should note the prohibition applies while the matter is under Commission consideration or court review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engineering/technical allotment criterion (minimum distance separations)
rubrics_metrics.description: The staff engineering analysis indicates Channel 284A can be allotted to Huntley, Montana, consistent with the minimum distance separation requirements of the Commission's rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To accommodate the proposed allotment, a site restriction of 13.9 km (8.6 miles) north of the community is required; the reference coordinates are 46-01-30 NL and 108-18-00 WL. Allotment must satisfy Commission minimum distance separation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order to Show Cause to affected licensee
rubrics_metrics.description: An Order to Show Cause has been issued to BMG Billings, LLC, licensee of KYSX, Billings, Montana, to show cause why the station license should not be modified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposed modification would specify operation on Channel 286A in lieu of reserved Channel 283C1 at Billings, Montana; licensee must respond as directed by the Order to Show Cause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official-document reliance and format
rubrics_metrics.description: The XML on FederalRegister.gov is an unofficial prototype; use the linked PDF for the official electronic format and verify against official editions for legal research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This site does not provide legal notice until ACFR grants it official status; only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507. Each document includes a link to the corresponding official PDF file on govinfo.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act / Regulatory Flexibility Act status
rubrics_metrics.description: This document does not contain proposed information collection requirements subject to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 and Provisions of the Regulatory Flexibility Act of 1980 do not apply to this proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thus, there are no PRA burdens proposed and the RFA analysis is not required/applicable for this proceeding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing Accountability Through Transparency Act requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies must post online a brief plain-language summary of the proposed rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Commission will publish the required summary of this NPRM on https://www.fcc.gov/proposed-rulemakings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed amendment to CFR table of allotments
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes to amend 47 CFR part 73, §73.202 Table of Allotments by adding Huntley, Montana—Channel 284A.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule text provides exact wording to be added to Table 1 to paragraph (b) under Montana and shows the printed changes for the Federal Register amendment.
